_comment: Synthetic run metadata for the manual test path in security-notify.yml.
It exists so that `Send a synthetic TEST report` can prove the whole
delivery path — rendering, redaction, the provider call, the recipient —
without waiting for a real assessment to go red.
Everything here is invented. The repository and run id are deliberately
recognisable as fake so that a TEST message can never be mistaken for a
real finding, and notify.py additionally stamps TEST into the subject and
says 'Synthetic data' in the body when --mode test is used.
This file carries no findings of its own: --mode test builds the synthetic
finding set inside notify.py, where it is covered by verify-notify.sh.
